status: DRAFT FOR COUNSEL. UNAUDITED prototype. Not legal advice. v0.2: every ISO 3166-1 code listed; researched entries carry source ids (compliance/research/sources.json, exact sentences); every unresearched code is restricted-review (denied); no country is allowed until counsel decides (Q-2).
rule: Deny by default. A request is allowed only if its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country is listed with tier 'allowed' AND its ISO 3166-2 subdivision (when known) is not listed in 'subdivisions' as blocked AND no anonymizer rule denies it. Any country not listed, an unknown country (missing header, 'XX', 'T1', private or unresolvable IP), and tier 'restricted-review' are all denied.

blocked.meaning: No access to trading at all (no order, no deposit credit, no wallet connection in the UI). Read-only public market data and the escape-hatch/withdraw-only flow remain: see compliance/geoblock/DESIGN.md.

restricted-review.meaning: Counsel must decide. Denied until decided.

allowed.meaning: No restriction identified in the research at the stated confidence; counsel confirms before launch.

research.note: informational (agent 397's loader accepts only listed top-level keys; decision code ignores this)

counsel_questions.Q-1: Sanctioned countries: may exit-only (cancel, reduce-only close, withdraw) stay open to a user located there, or must funds be frozen as for a listed address? 0.2 keeps 354's exit-only policy until counsel decides.
counsel_questions.Q-2: Which countries, if any, may be 'allowed' at launch for a perpetuals venue whose frontend is operated by Bloch Inc (Panama)? 0.2 opens none (deny by default).
counsel_questions.Q-3: United States: do the 2026 CFTC developments (perpetuals on registered venues; foreign-futures relief through a U.S. FCM) change anything for an unregistered venue? Assumed no.
counsel_questions.Q-4: EU/EEA: does offering crypto perpetuals to EU residents from Panama without solicitation require MiFID II authorisation (reverse solicitation limits)?
counsel_questions.Q-5: Panama: does serving Panamanian residents require a licence (operator's home jurisdiction)? Not researched; denied meanwhile.
counsel_questions.Q-6: Syria and the occupied regions of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson: current EU/UK/UN status; kept blocked.
counsel_questions.Q-7: Australia, Singapore, Japan: do the retail leverage limits and registration regimes reach an offshore venue that does not solicit there; is a professional-investor route relevant? Blocked or denied meanwhile.
